title: spec(migrations): 219 semantic entries still carry the "No backticks in surface" workaround comment, and one family test still forbids a backtick, after #27532 fixed the renderer
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② a should-fix that a contract review marked as a follow-up sweep (record 6508719840 on PR #27724, ④). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 · `marchtian` · session `session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade yet: triage sets the grade.
Reader: the `domain:spec` seat, next PR a comment-and-test sweep in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` and `packages/spec/src/system/`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): semantic search "semantic migration entry No backticks in surface comment stale upgrade guide code span sweep" → 12 hits; only #27532 (the renderer fix itself, whose PR leaves this residue) is related. **New.**
reach: no shipped byte is wrong (the comments are source comments; the kept assertion still passes); the cost is governed source text that states something false about the renderer, and a test that refuses a future backtick for a reason that no longer exists.

## Measured (`origin/main` `ef359b95`, with PR #27724's renderer fix in mind)

- `grep -rl "No backticks" packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic | wc -l` → **219** files carry the comment "No backticks in `surface` — build-upgrade-guide renders it inside a code span already, and a nested backtick would close it." (#27532's card said only one entry avoided the defect this way; the count is 219.)
- `packages/spec/src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` L260–L262 asserts `expect(entry!.surface).not.toMatch(/BACKTICK/)` with the same stale reason ("the upgrade guide renders it inside a code span AND a table cell"). PR #27724 dropped the identical assertion from its two siblings (`export-job-family-retirement.test.ts`, `package-upgrade-family-retirement.test.ts`) and missed this one.
- Once PR #27724 lands, `build-upgrade-guide.ts` fences every `surface` by CommonMark §6.1 (`scripts/lib/markdown-code-span.ts`), so a backtick inside a surface renders correctly and the comment's claim is false.

## Wanted

- Delete the workaround comment from all 219 entry files (mechanical; no `surface`, `replacement`, `reason` or `acceptanceCriteria` byte moves).
- Drop the one remaining `not.toMatch(/BACKTICK/)` assertion and its stated reason in `compliance-families-retirement.test.ts`.
- Lands after PR #27724 (`Blocked-by:` it until it merges). No changeset owed if nothing published moves (comments in `src/**` do not ship as schema; confirm against the package's `files[]`).

**Clause-②:** likely `no`. **Metadata-protocol:** likely `none`.

type: Bug
